c07857bab7bc898d97729bf9de760b1366fe02a2: A resort on a human scale, Berwang focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 35 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with the family or for skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Berwang's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Berwang's moderate altitude — 1079 m at the base, 1743 m at the summit — makes it sensitive to climatic variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before setting off is strongly advised. The budget for a stay in Berwang is clearly high: a 71€ day pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence — but you need to be aware of it before leaving. In short: Berwang doesn't rival the giants of skiing but doesn't pretend to. It is an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.

c0fda5bb1c93c6d6be5725af0b3b1ab8490e26f3: A resort on a human scale, Glacier du Stubai focuses on warm welcomes and proximity rather than impressive figures. Its 65 km of runs are ideal for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Glacier du Stubai's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for learning to ski with children. As for snow, Glacier du Stubai is in a strong position with its summit at 3210 m: even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1695 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December. The budget for a stay at Glacier du Stubai is clearly high: €73 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and high-altitude restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Glacier du Stubai delivers on its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most skier profiles without disappointing.
